body: “Barselona”, “Bavariya” va “Manchester Siti”ning sobiq bosh murabbiyi Pep Gvardiola “Inter Mayami” hujumchisi Lionel Messiga tenglasha oladigan yangi oʻyinchilar bormi degan savolga javob berdi.

“Hech kim tenglasha olmaydi. Yaxshi oʻyinchilar koʻp, lekin men hech kimning bu darajaga yetib borishini, 15-20 yil davomida har uch kunda bunday yuqori darajada oʻynashini tasavvur qila olmayman. Bunday oʻyinchini hech qachon boshqa koʻrmayman deb oʻylayman. Yillar davomida yangilanmagan rekordlar bor, lekin oxir-oqibat ularni kimdir yangilaydi. Balki Useyn Boltning rekordlari qachondir yangilanar, lekin shuncha yil davomida yuqori darajada oʻynay oladigan futbolchi boshqa chiqmasa kerak... Men buni tasavvur qila olmayman", deya Gvardiolaning soʻzlarini keltiradi ESPN.

Eslatib oʻtamiz, Gvardiola va Messi 2008-yildan 2012-yilgacha “Barselona”da birga ishlagan. Bu vaqt ichida argentinalik futbolchi ketma-ket toʻrt marta “Oltin toʻp”ni qoʻlga kiritdi va Kataloniya klubi ikkita Chempionlar Ligasi kubogini va uchta Ispaniya ligasi chempionligini qoʻlga kiritdi.

items.title: 'Man Utd being relegated would be the biggest shock in history... but it won't happen'
items.summary: In his latest Sky Sports column, Paul Merson previews a big weekend for Manchester United, before Arsenal take on Manchester City in a huge game live this Sunday.
body: Mauricio Pochettino is looking for his first win as United boss as he bids to take them out of the relegation zone. However, Brentford visit Old Trafford on the back of their recent win over Everton, which took them into the top six. Got Sky? Watch Premier League games LIVE on your phone \ud83d\udcf1 Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream PL games with no contract \ud83d\udcfa Then on Sunday, Arsenal host title rivals Man City. Enzo Maresca's side are already six points behind the reigning champions and have won just two out of their last seven matches in all competitions. Read below for the Magic Man's thoughts ahead of a huge weekend in the Premier League... 'Brentford game is massive for Man Utd' Manchester United are in trouble. 100 per cent. Of course they are. But I don't see them getting relegated, absolutely not. I would be shocked and amazed, it would be the biggest shock in the history of anything. People will go: Mike Tyson got beat by Buster Douglas. But that was one punch. This is over 38 games. Brentford is a massive football match for them. If they lost that game, I don't see them beating Newcastle if Matthias Jaissle's side get anywhere near the level they played against Arsenal in the second half. Then by the time you're playing Coventry, you're more than a win away from getting out of trouble. As soon as that starts happening, that's when it starts getting worrying - when you need two weeks to get out of the bottom three, or four or five points away. The next three weeks are massive for United. If they beat Brentford this week, that will settle them down. But I look at the teams down there right now. Crystal Palace won't go to Old Trafford and win. Sunderland and Nottingham Forest won't. Fulham and Coventry won't. Hull won't. So that means to me that Man Utd are better than them. That's why I don't see them getting relegated. When you look at it like that, there are a lot of worse teams than them. Man Utd have bought too many 'four or nines' - that's what I call them. They're either 4\/10 or 9\/10. They're not in between. You can't do that at Man Utd. You have to be between a seven or an eight on a consistent basis. You can't be four one week and nine the next, it doesn't work. The pace of the game is controlled by the other team, it's never controlled by Manchester United. They have got no defenders. They've gone it horribly wrong, trying to build from front to back. But it's more than that, it's spine of the team. They need a centre forward. They don't have a dictating midfield player who comes short and controls the game. The only way United can do that is if they sacrifice Fernandes going forward and playing him deeper, like a quarterback - and then hope you've got enough going forwards elsewhere. I don't see anyone else in that United team who is capable of coming deep and playing the ball forward. Playing that pass on a consistent basis, making the right decisions. 'Man City have lost their fear factor' Man City have got to go out and play for the fans, they're the ones who are paying their money. They're getting paid \u00a3300,000-a-week, the fans are the ones paying to watch them. Man City are getting a little bit found out. I have always said, even when they were playing at their best, they give you chances. And you have to make those chances count. It used to be: go to the Etihad, get your stomach's tickled, get out with a 3-0 defeat that you're more than happy with that, and go back on the coach - because they could win games by six or seven. Then all of a sudden, they started winning games but they were also open at the same time. And now, teams don't fear them. Teams know they will get chances if they have a go at them - and enough chances to win football matches, not just one or two chances. If you are brave enough - like Fulham were by getting players in the opposition box - you can beat Man City. This is the problem for them: they're too open and there's not that fear factor anymore. And I also don't think Erling Haaland gets the service he deserves. You would like to think that City's players aren't being affected by the charges hanging over them, because no one knows what is going to happen. So you have to play until you know what's going to happen. It's like life: no one's going to tell you what's going to happen tomorrow, so live today. 'If Arsenal beat Man City, the league could be over soon' If Arsenal win this game, the league is finished. That would be nine points clear and this league could be over very, very quickly. Arsenal were dominant in the first half against Newcastle and if it was a boxing match, then Newcastle would have thrown the towel in. They came out the second half a bit lackadaisical and Newcastle were outstanding by playing on the front foot. But then Arsenal switched and decided they weren't going to lose. And then they scored one of the best goals of the season. If the finish from Noni Madueke was good, it would be the goal of the season. But when you see the finish, it's not great and the goalkeeper should save it. If he whips it into the far corner, it's goal of the season. I think we saw enough with Brighton last weekend against Hull. That's one of those games where you go: if you can't win it, don't lose it. You feel sorry for Brighton, because Konstantinos Tzolakis was unreal. He should be playing for the New York Rangers this weekend. He was like an ice hockey goalkeeper. But if you're experienced team and you've been in that situation before, a draw is just a bad day at the office but we've played well, the goalkeeper's had a blinder and you don't lose a football match away from home. But they lost. uz.title: "MYu"ning quyi ligaga tushib ketishi tarixdagi eng katta zarba boʻlardi... lekin bu sodir boʻlmaydi"
uz.summary: Oʻzining Sky Sports nashridagi soʻnggi ruknida Pol Merson "Manchester Yunayted" uchun ajoyib dam olish kunlarini, yakshanba kuni "Arsenal" "Manchester Siti"ga qarshi yirik oʻyinda jonli ravishda jonli ravishda taqdim etadi.
body: Maurisio Pochettino "Yunayted" bosh murabbiyi sifatida oʻzining birinchi gʻalabasini kutmoqda, chunki u ularni quyi ligaga tushirish zonasidan olib chiqishni taklif qilmoqda. Biroq, Brentford "Old Trafford"ga yaqinda "Everton" ustidan qozonilgan gʻalaba ortidan tashrif buyurib, kuchli oltilikka kirgan. Sky bormi? Premer-liga oʻyinlarini jonli efirda telefoningizda tomosha qiling \ud83d\udcf1 Not got Sky? Eng soʻnggi Sky Sports takliflari yoki shartnomasiz PL oʻyinlarini translatsiya qilish \ud83d\udcfa Keyin yakshanba kuni "Arsenal" chempionlik uchun raqib "Man Siti"ni qabul qiladi. Enzo Mareska shogirdlari amaldagi chempionlardan 6 ochko ortda qolib ketishdi va barcha musobaqalardagi soʻnggi 7 uchrashuvdan faqat ikkitasida gʻalaba qozonishdi. Sehrli odamning Premer-ligadagi ajoyib dam olish kunlari oldidan fikrlari uchun quyida oʻqing... "Brentford" oʻyini "MYu" uchun juda katta" "Manchester Yunayted" muammoga duch keldi. 100 foiz. Albatta ular. Lekin men ularning quyi ligaga tushib qolishlarini koʻrmayapman, mutlaqo yoʻq. Men hayratda va hayratda boʻlardim, bu har qanday narsa tarixidagi eng katta zarba boʻlardi. Odamlar ketadi: Mayk Tayson Buster Duglas tomonidan kaltaklandi. Ammo bu bitta zarba edi. Bu 38 dan ortiq oʻyin. Brentford ular uchun katta futbol oʻyini. Agar ular oʻsha oʻyinda magʻlub boʻlishsa, Mattias Jaissl shogirdlari ikkinchi boʻlimda "Arsenal"ga qarshi oʻynagan darajaga yaqinlashsa, "Nyukasl"ni magʻlub etishlarini koʻrmayapman. Shunda siz Koventri oʻynagan vaqtingizda muammodan xalos boʻlishdan koʻra koʻproq gʻalaba qozonasiz. Bu sodir boʻlishi bilanoq, u tashvishlana boshlaydi - pastki uchlikdan chiqish uchun ikki hafta kerak boʻlganda yoki toʻrt yoki besh ochko uzoqda. Keyingi uch hafta "Yunayted" uchun juda katta. Agar ular ushbu haftada Brentfordni magʻlub etishsa, bu ularni hal qiladi. Lekin men hozir u yerdagi jamoalarga qarayman. "Kristal Pelas" "Old Trafford"ga bormaydi va gʻalaba qozonmaydi. "Sanderlend" va "Nottingem Forest" oʻynamaydi. “Fulxem” va “Koventri” bunga qodir emas. Hull buni qilmaydi. Demak, bu men uchun “MYu” ulardan yaxshiroq ekanligini anglatadi. SHu bois ularni quyi ligaga tushib qolishlarini koʻrmayapman. Bunday qarasangiz, ulardan ham yomonroq jamoalar koʻp. "MYu" juda koʻp "toʻrt yoki toʻqqizta" sotib oldi - men ularni shunday deb atayman. Ular 4\/10 yoki 9\/10. Ular orasida emas. “MYu”da buni qila olmaysiz. Doimiy ravishda etti yoki sakkiz orasida boʻlishingiz kerak. Siz bir haftada toʻrtta va keyingi toʻqqizda boʻlolmaysiz, bu ishlamaydi. Oʻyin sur’atini boshqa jamoa boshqaradi, uni “Manchester Yunayted” hech qachon boshqara olmaydi. Ularda himoyachilar yoʻq. Oldindan orqaga qarab qurishga urinib, dahshatli xato qilishdi. Lekin bundan ham koʻproq narsa, bu jamoaning umurtqa pogʻonasi. Ularga markaziy hujumchi kerak. Ularda oʻyinni boshqaradigan va oʻyinni boshqaradigan oʻyinchi yoʻq. "Yunayted" buni qilishning yagona yoʻli, agar ular Fernandesni oldinga oʻtishni qurbon qilsalar va uni chorak himoyachi kabi chuqurroq oʻynasalar - va keyin boshqa joyda etarlicha oldinga oʻtishga umid qilaman. Men oʻsha “Yunayted” jamoasida chuqur kirib, oldinga toʻp sura oladigan boshqa hech kimni koʻrmayapman. Oʻsha pasni izchil oʻynash, toʻgʻri qaror qabul qilish. "Man Siti qoʻrquv omilini yoʻqotdi" "Man Siti" tashqariga chiqib, muxlislar uchun oʻynashi kerak, ular pullarini toʻlashmoqda. Ular haftasiga 3300 000 maosh olishadi, muxlislar esa ularni tomosha qilish uchun pul toʻlaydilar. "Man Siti" biroz oʻrganilmoqda. Men har doim aytganman, hattoki ular eng yaxshi oʻynaganlarida ham, ular sizga imkoniyat berishadi. Va siz bu imkoniyatlarni hisobga olishingiz kerak. Ilgari shunday edi: Etihadga boring, qorningizni qitiqlang, 3:0 hisobidagi magʻlubiyat bilan chiqib, bundan xursand boʻling va murabbiyga qayting - chunki ular olti yoki etti oʻyinda gʻalaba qozonishlari mumkin edi. Keyin toʻsatdan ular oʻyinlarda gʻalaba qozona boshladilar, lekin ular bir vaqtning oʻzida ochiq edi. Va endi, jamoalar ulardan qoʻrqmaydi. Jamoalar ularda imkoniyatga ega boʻlishlarini bilishadi - va futbol oʻyinlarida gʻalaba qozonish uchun bir yoki ikkita imkoniyat emas, balki etarli imkoniyatlar. Agar siz jasoratli boʻlsangiz - "Fulxem" kabi oʻyinchilarni raqib maydonchasiga jalb qilish orqali - siz "Man Siti"ni magʻlub eta olasiz. Bu ular uchun muammo: ular juda ochiq va endi qoʻrquv omili yoʻq. Menimcha, Erling Xoland oʻzi munosib xizmat koʻrsata olmaydi. "Siti" futbolchilariga qoʻyilgan ayblovlar ta'sir qilmayapti deb oʻylaysiz, chunki nima boʻlishini hech kim bilmaydi. Shunday qilib, nima boʻlishini bilmaguningizcha oʻynashingiz kerak. Bu hayotga oʻxshaydi: hech kim sizga ertaga nima boʻlishini aytmaydi, shuning uchun bugun yashang. "Agar "Arsenal" "Man Siti"ni magʻlub etsa, liga tez orada tugaydi" Agar "Arsenal" bu oʻyinda gʻalaba qozonsa, liga tugadi. Bu toʻqqiz ochko aniq boʻlardi va bu liga juda, juda tez tugashi mumkin edi. "Arsenal" "Nyukasl"ga qarshi birinchi boʻlimda ustunlik qildi va agar boks oʻyini boʻlsa, unda "Nyukasl" sochiqni ichkariga tashlagan boʻlardi. Ular ikkinchi boʻlimda biroz kamtar chiqishdi va "Nyukasl" oldingi oyoqda oʻynab ajoyib edi. Ammo keyin "Arsenal" oʻzgardi va yutqazmaslikka qaror qildi. Va keyin ular mavsumning eng yaxshi gollaridan birini urishdi. Agar Noni Maduekening marrasi yaxshi boʻlsa, bu mavsumning maqsadi boʻlardi. Ammo marrani koʻrsangiz, bu ajoyib emas va darvozabon uni saqlab qolishi kerak. Agar u uni uzoq burchakka qamchilasa, bu mavsumning maqsadi. Oʻylaymanki, biz "Brayton" bilan oʻtgan hafta oxirida "Xall"ga qarshi oʻyinda yetarlicha koʻrdik. Bu siz boradigan oʻyinlardan biri: agar gʻalaba qozona olmasangiz, uni yutqazmang. Siz Braytonga achinasiz, chunki Konstantinos Tzolakis haqiqiy emas edi. U shu hafta oxirida Nyu-York Reynjersda oʻynashi kerak. U xuddi xokkey darvozabonidek edi. Agar siz tajribali jamoa boʻlsangiz va avval ham shunday vaziyatda boʻlgan boʻlsangiz, durang - bu ofisda shunchaki yomon kun, lekin biz yaxshi oʻynadik, darvozabonning koʻzi ojiz va siz uydan tashqarida boʻlib oʻtadigan futbol oʻyinida magʻlub boʻlmaysiz. Ammo ular magʻlub boʻlishdi. items.title: Why Cambridgeshire derby could be season-defining
items.summary: Peterborough United and Cambridge United are set for a potentially season-defining local derby at London Road.
body: Why Cambridgeshire derby could be season-defining
Image source, Getty Images
Robbie Savage's Peterborough United will seek to defend a long unbeaten home record in the Cambridgeshire derby when Neil Harris's U's visit London Road
ByKris Holland
BBC Sport, East of England
History, tradition, bragging rights.
Local derbies are always special, but none more so than when they have the ability to shape the narrative of a season. This much is true of Saturday's Cambridgeshire derby (12:30 GMT).
Robbie Savage's Peterborough United welcome Neil Harris' Cambridge United to London Road with both at something of a crossroads.

At stake for Posh? Their League One status. Despite an impressive win at Plymouth Argyle last time out, they remain 22nd in the table and need results to avoid a battle against the drop being the defining theme of their season.

As for the U's, the derby presents an opportunity to regain momentum. After October's 2-1 win at Barnsley they were one point off top spot, but failure to pick up three points in any of their five league games since leaves them caught between play-off contention and mid-table drift.
'It's all about winning'
The derby also carries the weight of recent history, with the emotional baggage greater for the U's.
They have lost each of their past seven away league games against Peterborough, losing those matches by a combined 20-3 scoreline.
Indeed, they have not won at London Road since an FA Cup tie in 1994-95, while their wait for a league win at their rivals' home extends to 1990.
Savage, appointed last month, said his side were well aware of their responsibility for continuing that record.
"We don't want to be the group that loses to Cambridge at home, first time in 30 years I think it would be," he said.
"We don't want to be that group. We want to put three, four, five past them and win the game. Even if it's 1-0, it doesn't matter.
"It's all about winning, don't care we win, just win the game."
Robbie Savage: 'We want to turn the county blue'

The victory at Plymouth ended a four-game wait for a win, and Savage said the onus was on his side to back it up on derby day. If they do, they know they will have secured successive league victories for the first time since February.
"This game is at the top of the mountain," he said.
"No doubt about it. The players will be up for it, we've shown them videos of the previous games, we've got fans sending messages.
"We're doing everything we can to make them realise how big this game is. It's not another game, it's the derby. A great game.
"Neil knows what it means. We're two passionate managers. He's done far better than me as a manager so far, so hats off to him. But we both want to win.
"They will bring 1,600 fans and we need to show Cambridge that we want to county to be blue."
Neil Harris: 'We'll attack the game like no other'
While this derby is new territory for Savage, Harris comes armed with the memory of defeat in his only previous taste of the tie in a season than ultimately ended with relegation for the U's.
After securing a return to the third-tier in 2025-26 - and having made a competitive start to this campaign - there is no shortage of motivation to deliver a long-awaited win for his side.
"It is a one-off fixture," he told BBC Look East.
"There is a slightly different feel and mentality to it, but it means a hell of a lot to a hell of a lot of people.
"It means a lot to get bragging rights over a direct opponent. It's important to get back to our highest standards."
Posh have lost just one of their past 12 league games against Cambridge United, winning their past four in succession.
But with Savage's side in a precarious league position, there is optimism among fans that their 36-year long wait to celebrate a league win at London Road could finally arrive.
"It's about playing with heart and emotion, but brains as well," added Harris.
"We understand the importance of the fixture, I understand it as a driven manager. It's about trying to make sure we make our fans proud."

uz.title: Nima uchun Kembrijshir derbisi mavsumni belgilovchi boʻlishi mumkin
uz.summary: Peterboro Yunayted va Kembrij Yunayted London Roadda potentsial mavsumni aniqlaydigan mahalliy derbiga tayyor.
body: Nima uchun Kembrijshir derbisi mavsumni belgilovchi boʻlishi mumkin
Tasvir manbai, Getty Images
Robbi Savajning Piterboro Yunayted jamoasi Nil Xarrisning U London Roadga tashrif buyurganida, Kembridjshir derbisida uzoq vaqtdan beri magʻlub boʻlmagan uy rekordini himoya qilishga intiladi.
Kris Holland tomonidan
BBC Sport, Sharqiy Angliya
Tarix, an'analar, maqtanchoqlik.
Mahalliy derbilar har doim oʻziga xosdir, ammo ular mavsumning hikoyasini shakllantirish qobiliyatiga ega boʻlganidan farq qiladi. Bu shanba kungi Kembrijshir derbisiga (GMT 12:30) tegishli.
Robbi Savajning "Piterboro Yunayted" jamoasi Nil Xarrisning Kembrij Yunayted jamoasini London Roadda ikkalasi ham chorrahada kutib oladi.

Posh uchun xavf bormi? Ularning Birinchi Liga holati. Oxirgi marta Plimut Argyleda ajoyib gʻalaba qozonganiga qaramay, ular jadvalda 22-oʻrinda qolmoqdalar va mavsumning hal qiluvchi mavzusi boʻlgan pasayish bilan kurashdan qochish uchun natijalar kerak.

U.ga keladigan boʻlsak, derbi kuchni tiklash uchun imkoniyat yaratadi. Oktyabr oyida Barnslida boʻlib oʻtgan 2:1 hisobidagi gʻalabadan soʻng, ular birinchi oʻrindan bir ochko ortda qolishdi, lekin ligadagi beshta oʻyinning birortasida ham uch ochko toʻplay olmagani uchun ularni pley-off bahslari va oʻrta jadvaldagi drift oʻrtasida qoldirdi.
"Hammasi gʻalaba qozonishda"
Derbi, shuningdek, yaqin tarixning ogʻirligini koʻtaradi, U uchun hissiy yuk koʻproq.
Ular "Piterboro"ga qarshi oʻtgan yettita safar oʻyinining har birida magʻlub boʻlishdi va bu oʻyinlarda umumiy hisobda 20:3 hisobida magʻlub boʻlishdi.

Haqiqatan ham, ular 1994-95 yilgi Angliya kubogidagi durangdan buyon London Roudda gʻalaba qozona olmagan, shu bilan birga raqiblar uyida ligada gʻalaba qozonishni kutishlari 1990 yilgacha davom etadi.
Oʻtgan oy tayinlangan Savage, uning tomoni bu rekordni davom ettirish uchun mas'uliyatni yaxshi bilishini aytdi.
"Biz oʻz uyimizda Kembrijga yutqazadigan guruh boʻlishni xohlamaymiz, 30 yil ichida birinchi marta shunday boʻladi deb oʻylayman", dedi u.
"Biz bu guruh boʻlishni istamaymiz. Biz ulardan uch, toʻrt, beshtasini qoʻyib, oʻyinda gʻalaba qozonishni istaymiz. Garchi 1:0 boʻlsa ham, bu muhim emas.
"Hammasi gʻalaba qozonishda, gʻalaba qozonishimizga ahamiyat bermang, faqat oʻyinda gʻalaba qozoning."
Robbi Savaj: "Biz okrugni koʻk rangga aylantirmoqchimiz"

Plimutdagi gʻalaba toʻrtta oʻyindan iborat gʻalabani kutishga yakun yasadi va Savage derbi kuni uni qoʻllab-quvvatlash mas'uliyati uning tomonida ekanligini aytdi. Agar shunday qilsalar, ular fevral oyidan beri birinchi marta ketma-ket liga gʻalabalarini qoʻlga kiritishlarini bilishadi.
“Bu oʻyin togʻning choʻqqisida”, — dedi u.
“Shubhasiz. Oʻyinchilar bunga tayyor boʻlishadi, biz ularga avvalgi oʻyinlarning videolarini koʻrsatdik, muxlislarimiz xabarlar joʻnatmoqda.
"Biz ular bu oʻyin qanchalik katta ekanligini tushunishlari uchun qoʻlimizdan kelganini qilamiz. Bu boshqa oʻyin emas, bu derbi. Ajoyib oʻyin.

“Nil bu nimani anglatishini biladi. Biz ikki ishtiyoqli menejermiz. U hozirgacha menejer sifatida mendan ancha yaxshi natijalarga erishdi, shuning uchun unga shlyapa qoʻyadi. Lekin ikkalamiz ham gʻalaba qozonishni xohlaymiz.
"Ular 1600 muxlisni olib kelishadi va biz Kembrijga koʻk boʻlishni xohlayotganimizni koʻrsatishimiz kerak."
Nil Xarris: "Biz oʻyinga boshqalar kabi hujum qilamiz"
Bu derbi Savage uchun yangi hudud boʻlsa-da, Xarris oʻzining avvalgi mavsumdagi magʻlubiyati xotirasi bilan qurollangan boʻlib, yakunda U ligasiga tushib ketish bilan yakunlangan edi.
2025-26-yilda uchinchi darajaga qaytishni ta'minlagan va ushbu kampaniyani raqobatbardosh boshlaganidan soʻng, uning jamoasi uchun uzoq kutilgan gʻalabani ta'minlash uchun motivatsiya kam emas.
"Bu bir martalik uchrashuv", dedi u BBC Look Eastga.
“Unda biroz boshqacha tuygʻu va mentalitet bor, lekin bu koʻpchilik uchun doʻzaxni anglatadi.
“Toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri raqib ustidan maqtanish huquqiga ega boʻlish juda koʻp narsani anglatadi. Eng yuqori standartlarimizga qaytish juda muhim”.
Poshliklar Kembrij Yunaytedga qarshi ligadagi soʻnggi 12 oʻyinining faqat bittasida magʻlub boʻlishdi va oxirgi toʻrttasida ketma-ket gʻalaba qozonishdi.
Ammo Savage jamoasi xavfli liga holatiga koʻra, muxlislarda 36 yillik uzoq kutilgan London Roudda ligadagi gʻalabani nishonlash nihoyat yetib kelishi mumkin degan optimizm bor.
"Bu yurak va his-tuygʻular bilan oʻynash haqida, lekin miyalar ham", deya qoʻshimcha qildi Xarris.
"Biz oʻyinning muhimligini tushunamiz, men buni gʻayratli menejer sifatida tushunaman. Bu biz muxlislarimizni faxrlantirishga harakat qilishdir."

body: Saudiya Arabistonining “An-Nassr” klubi hujumchisi Krishtianu Ronaldu 2026/27-yilgi mavsum yakunlanganidan soʻng futbolchilik faoliyatini davom ettirish yoki ettirmaslik borasida hali bir qarorga kelmagan. 41 yoshli portugaliyalik yulduz yakuniy qarorni joriy mavsum yakuniga yetgach qabul qilishni rejalashtirmoqda.

Jurnalist Abdulaziz Al-Osaymining xabar berishicha, Ronaldu yaqinlariga hozircha faoliyatini yakunlash haqida e’lon qilish niyati yoʻqligini aytgan. Hujumchi avval mavsum yakunidagi vaziyatni baholab, shundan keyin kelajakdagi rejalari boʻyicha qaror qabul qilmoqchi.
Avvalroq Ronaldu 2026/27-yilgi mavsum yakunida “An-Nassr”ni tark etishi mumkinligi, futbolchi bu haqda klub rahbariyatini ham ogohlantirib qoʻygani haqida xabarlar tarqalgan edi.

Ma’lumot uchun, Ronaldu 2023-yilning yanvaridan buyon “An-Nassr” sharafini himoya qilib kelmoqda. Uning riyodliklar bilan amaldagi shartnomasi 2027-yilning yoziga qadar moʻljallangan. Portugaliyalik hujumchi hozirga qadar jamoa safida barcha musobaqalar doirasida jami 161 ta rasmiy uchrashuvda maydonga tushib, oʻz hisobiga 139 ta gol va 23 ta golli uzatma yozdirib qoʻygan.

Eslatib oʻtamiz, Ronaldu shu paytga qadar Portugaliyaning “Sporting”, Angliyaning “Manchester Yunayted”, Madridning “Real” hamda Turinning “Yuventus” jamoalarida ham toʻp tepgan. U besh karra Yevropa Chempionlar Ligasi gʻolibi va besh karra “Oltin toʻp” sohibi sanaladi.
